outcome: Time between start of induction and birth
Time between start of induction and transition to birth room
Rate of caesarean sections for induction failure
cohort: The study involved 100 women with singleton pregnancies, fetuses in cephalic presentation, a term >37 weeks, and a Bishop score lower than 6 after cervical balloon catheter ripening.
finding: The study found no significant difference in vaginal delivery rates between women who received vaginal prostaglandins or oral misoprostol as a second line of cervical ripening after cervical balloon catheter use.
